verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's pricing page evidence shows some of the key cost drivers a PM would want—unlimited seats/no per-seat pricing, usage-based billing, AI Runs, session replay/error caps, unlimited flags—and community commentary corroborates MAU-based billing and even flags it as expensive, giving independent confirmation of cost dynamics. However, there's no evidence of concrete tier breakdowns, exact request/event pricing thresholds, or a full pricing calculator, so a PM can't fully model cost before committing. Missing for 10: detailed tiered pricing table, explicit MAU/event/request rate cards, and independent hands-on confirmation of final invoiced costs.
